arguments.value: George H. Wu, born in 1950 in New York, New York, is a judge of the U.S. District Court for the Central District of California. He earned a B.A. from Pomona College in 1972 and a J.D. from the University of Chicago Law School in 1975. He practiced law in Los Angeles, served as a law clerk to Judge Stanley N. Barnes of the U.S. Court of Appeals for the Ninth Circuit, and was an assistant professor at the University of Tennessee College of Law. He later served as an assistant U.S. attorney in the Central District of California, as a judge of the Los Angeles Municipal Court, and as a judge of the Superior Court of California, County of Los Angeles, before his nomination to the federal bench by President George W. Bush and confirmation by the Senate in 2007.
